children.name: Charistephane
children.description: Charistephane — a genus of mertensiid comb jellies in the family Mertensiidae.

children.name: Charistephane fugiens
children.description: Charistephane is a monotypic genus of ctenophores belonging to the family Mertensiidae. The only species in this genus is Charistephane fugiens.

children.name: Mertensia
children.description: Mertensia — a genus of mertensiid comb jellies in the family Mertensiidae.

children.name: Mertensia ovum
children.description: Mertensia ovum, also known as the Arctic comb jelly or sea nut, is a cydippid comb jelly or ctenophore first described as Beroe ovum by Johan Christian Fabricius in 1780.

children.name: Callianira
children.description: Callianira — a genus of mertensiid comb jellies in the family Mertensiidae.

children.name: Callianira antarctica
children.description: Callianira antarctica is a species of ctenophore that physically resembles Mertensia ovum, but lacks the oil sacs.

children.name: Callianira bialata
children.description: Callianira bialata is a species of comb jelly within the family Mertensiidae.

children.name: Callianira cristata
children.description: Callianira cristata is a species of ctenophore of the family Mertensiidae.
